articles.summary: LOS ANGELES, October 6, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) – AXIL Brands, Inc. (“AXIL,” “we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: AXIL), an emerging global consumer products company for AXIL® hearing protection and enhancement products and Reviv3® hair and skin care products, and marketing services for third-party brands today announced financial and operational results for the first fiscal quarter ended August 31, 2026.
articles.title: AXIL Brands, Inc. Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results
